searches.query: how to reference breakpoint values in custom CSS using theme variables or media queries
Tailwind v4 exposes breakpoints as theme variables like --breakpoint-md. Use @media (width >= theme(--breakpoint-xl)) in custom CSS, or the --breakpoint-* variables with var().

input.intent: Tailwind v4: targeting a screen breakpoint inside custom CSS, e.g. to change a CSS variable at a breakpoint
